AR12.question: Keep using the same sheet, and merge the two recall directions into one paragraph at most 77 seconds long. Say which column is covered each time; recall from the other column before uncovering and checking.

history.content: I have a two-column Serbian word-and-meaning list and originally planned for 102 seconds of practice.
Practise both directions on that list.

value.answer: Mixed-direction recall on the same Serbian WORD / MEANING sheet, 77 seconds total. First 15 seconds: with the sheet on its single face, cover the MEANING column, read each Serbian WORD aloud and say its meaning before uncovering the MEANING column to check, then cover the MEANING column again before the next word; use this pass to refresh the list and note any weak items. Next 31 seconds: still on the same face, cover the WORD column, read each MEANING and write the Serbian word on paper before uncovering the WORD column to check, then cover the WORD column again before each new attempt; prioritise the weak items noted in the first pass while covering the whole list. Final 31 seconds: alternate directions item by item on the same sheet — for a word-to-meaning attempt keep the WORD visible and the MEANING covered, say the meaning, uncover MEANING to check, then cover MEANING again; for a meaning-to-word attempt keep the MEANING visible and the WORD covered, write the word, uncover WORD to check, then cover WORD again — and if any items were missed, spend the remaining time repeating just those missed items in the same alternating way, otherwise finish with the complete list once more.

Mixed-direction recall on the same Serbian WORD / MEANING sheet, 77 seconds total. First 15 seconds: with the sheet on its single face, cover the MEANING column, read each Serbian WORD aloud and say its meaning before uncovering the MEANING column to check, then cover the MEANING column again before the next word; use this pass to refresh the list and note any weak items. Next 31 seconds: still on the same face, cover the WORD column, read each MEANING and write the Serbian word on paper before uncovering the WORD column to check, then cover the WORD column again before each new attempt; prioritise the weak items noted in the first pass while covering the whole list. Final 31 seconds: alternate directions item by item on the same sheet — for a word-to-meaning attempt keep the WORD visible and the MEANING covered, say the meaning, uncover MEANING to check, then cover MEANING again; for a meaning-to-word attempt keep the MEANING visible and the WORD covered, write the word, uncover WORD to check, then cover WORD again — and if any items were missed, spend the remaining time repeating just those missed items in the same alternating way, otherwise finish with the complete list once more.

Keep the same two-column Serbian WORD / MEANING sheet on one face throughout, and work in both directions within 77 seconds. First, spend about 10 seconds writing or confirming a short WORD / MEANING list of the Serbian words you are studying with their known meanings, then immediately begin: cover the MEANING column, keep only the WORD column visible, say the meaning for the first word, uncover the MEANING column to check, and cover the MEANING column again before the next word; continue through the list this way for about 30 seconds, prioritising weak items. Then reverse direction: cover the WORD column, keep only the MEANING column visible, write the Serbian word on paper for the first meaning, uncover the WORD column to check, and cover the WORD column again before each new attempt; continue through the list for about 30 seconds, prioritising weak items. Finish with about 7 seconds: if any items were missed in either direction, repeat just those missed items once in the direction where they failed, covering the answer column each time and uncovering only to check; if there were no misses, stop or run once more through the complete list.
